title: An ALMA view of 11 dusty star-forming galaxies at the peak of cosmic star formation history
question: What are the spatially-resolved sizes, morphologies, molecular gas masses, and kinematics of 11 dusty star-forming galaxies at z~2 in the GOODS-S field, and how do dusty, gaseous, and stellar components and AGN activity drive their evolution?

recipe.goal: Select archival ALMA continuum maps and measure continuum flux densities and dust sizes
recipe.method: Select public ALMA archival maps with highest spatial resolution (<= 1 arcsec), perform 2D Gaussian fit using CASA task imfit to measure flux densities and angular axes, and convert to circularized physical radii using Eq. 2.
key_parameters: Delta theta <= 1 arcsec; flux error eS_nu = sqrt(rms^2 + (0.1 * S_nu)^2)
assumptions: Flat LambdaCDM cosmology with Omega_M = 0.32, Omega_Lambda = 0.63, h = 0.67; 10% flux calibration uncertainty; synthesized beam size as upper limit for unresolved sources

recipe.goal: Correct HST astrometry and compare optical and ALMA continuum morphology and sizes
recipe.method: Correct HST H160 image astrometry using Gaia source positions in the field, overlay ALMA continuum contours, and compute circularized optical-to-ALMA size ratios r_H / r_ALMA.
key_parameters: Mean astrometric offset: [+2, -10] x 10^-5 deg (Delta_RA ~ 70 mas, Delta_DEC ~ -360 mas); AzTEC.GS22 offset: [+15, +5] x 10^-5 deg; AzTEC.GS25: no correction

recipe.goal: Extract CO line profiles, redshifts, moment maps, intensities, and CO sizes
recipe.method: Rebin spectral channels of noisy ALMA cubes with CASA task imrebin, fit Gaussian profiles to 1D CO spectra, compute moment 0, 1, and 2 maps (and pv diagram for ALESS067.1), measure I_CO on mom0 maps, and measure CO sizes from peak separation of double-peaked components or beam upper limits.
key_parameters: Rebin factor x15 for UDF1, x5 for ALESS067.1 (2016.1.00564.S); pv diagram axis inclination ~70 degrees for ALESS067.1
assumptions: Distance between the peaks of the two spectral line components represents the CO emission size for unresolved double-peaked sources

recipe.goal: Derive CO luminosities, excitation ratios, molecular gas masses, and depletion timescales
recipe.method: Compute L'_CO from I_CO using Solomon et al. (1997) relation (Eq. 3), convert to L'_CO(1-0) using excitation ratios r_J1 (Eq. 4), multiply by alpha_CO to obtain M_H2 (Eq. 5), and compute depletion timescales.
assumptions: CO excitation ladder of Daddi et al. (2015) and conversion factor alpha_CO = 3.6 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 (with alternative alpha_CO = 1.8 giving a 0.5 scaling factor)

recipe.goal: Update broad-band SED fit of ALESS067.1 including radio and ALMA continuum fluxes
recipe.method: Fit multi-wavelength optical-to-radio SED of ALESS067.1 using CIGALE including synchrotron and free-free radio modules.
assumptions: Chabrier (2003) IMF, Bruzual & Charlot (2003) stellar libraries, Lo Faro et al. (2017) double power-law attenuation, Casey (2012) IR dust model, almost constant SFH

score_reason: All ALMA project codes and exact Member OUS identifiers are explicitly tabulated, data are public science-ready archive products, and analytical equations and CASA tasks (imfit, imrebin) are clearly stated; minor deductions for unstated moment-map velocity windows, spectral extraction apertures, and minor text-table inconsistencies.
